data.one_liner: Calculates the pole of inaccessibility for polygons to place labels optimally.
data.what_it_does: A Dart port of Mapbox's polylabel algorithm that identifies the pole of inaccessibility within a polygon. It determines the most interior point of a polygon along with its distance to the polygon boundary. This enables optimal positioning for text labels or markers on complex shapes.
use_when: Placing labels or center points visually inside complex polygon geometries on maps
Finding the most interior point of a 2D shape without using dart:math Point objects
avoid_when: Simple bounding box center or centroid arithmetic is sufficient for regular shapes
strengths: Avoids dart:math Point to reduce generic casting overhead and improve performance
Modern Dart API using records for coordinates and return values
Supports all Dart and Flutter platforms with no native dependencies
weaknesses: Not backwards compatible with the older polylabel package
Limited documentation beyond the basic invocation snippet
